provenance: Initial full-packet scenario contract grounded in current-source normal and hostile-key reproduction. All test links remain planned; no persistent test, implementation, human acceptance, or certification is claimed.

scenarios.title: Normal brief output and refusals do not move

gherkin.given: the committed four-lane brief fixture and existing invalid-input controls
gherkin.when: composeBrief evaluates the ordinary fixture after caller-keyed map hardening
gherkin.then: it returns ok true with lane order held watchlist completedResearch inferredRelevance, subject order MSFT BND ZZTOP semiconductors, and unchanged local and shared-policy refusal precedence

obligations.requiredProof: The exported production composer returns the exact ordinary lane and subject order from the committed fixture.

testMechanism.negativeControl: An in-memory source mutation that swaps the held and watchlist entries in LANE_ORDER must fail the exact normal-order assertion while the unmodified source retains its refusal controls.

linkedTests.testId: BUG-007: normal brief order and refusal precedence remain unchanged

expectedAssertions: lane and subject order match the committed control
existing refusal code reason field and precedence do not move

scenarios.title: Prototype-sensitive completion subjects are ordinary keys

gherkin.given: a completion subject is __proto__ constructor or toString and shared built-ins are snapshotted
gherkin.when: exported composeBrief evaluates the complete subject matrix
gherkin.then: every call returns through the declared result contract without throwing, treats the subject as an own key with actual evidence and no-action state, keeps absent owner and prior-evidence entries absent, changes no shared built-in, and leaves no cleanup residue

obligations.requiredProof: One persistent matrix executes all three exact subject strings through exported composeBrief and asserts own-key output.
No hostile subject throws or escapes the declared result contract, and absent caller lookup entries remain absent.

testMechanism.negativeControl: Restoring the caller-keyed maps to ordinary object allocation must reproduce a throw or built-in mutation for the exact subject matrix.

linkedTests.testId: BUG-007: prototype-sensitive completion subjects are safe own keys

expectedAssertions: all three subject keys return without throw
all three subject keys remain own data
shared built-ins and cleanup state remain unchanged
